name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my custom home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my custom home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting the right general contractor involves several key steps. Look for contractors with proven experience in custom home renovations, a strong portfolio of completed projects, and positive client references. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they are qualified and protected. Schedule consultations to discuss your vision, assess their communication style, and obtain detailed bids. Choose a contractor who demonstrates transparency, clear communication, and a comprehensive understanding of your project's unique requirements and your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, portfolio, references, licensing, insurance, clear communication, and a detailed understanding of your project.
